dataset: Selected GNCTD land acquisition award PDF facts extracted and manually reconciled for research prototype
authority: Department of Revenue, Government of NCT of Delhi
method: Reviewed official award PDFs and extracted citation-backed project, notification, parcel-list, area, status-quo and compensation facts. No individual claimant names are copied. OCR/layout ambiguities remain explicitly flagged. This is not a complete Delhi or India acquisition register.

limitations: Only two selected Delhi award PDFs are fully extracted in this curated dataset; 19 award PDFs are indexed in the catalogue but not all have been parsed.
Award record identifies acquisition-stage facts, not current owner or mutation status.
Khasra schedule entries are source-level parcel identifiers, not proof of present ownership.
Area units are left in Bigha-Biswa; no universal conversion factor is applied.
Compensation awarded is not proof that each person has been paid.
No personal claimant names, contact details or identity numbers are copied.
This selected public dataset is not a complete all-India land-acquisition register.
